name: vettarr
description: vettarr takes a link, a Telegram post, a magnet, a .torrent file or a Seerr request, looks the title up and checks it against rules you write: certification, IMDb parents guide, TMDB genres and keywords, size, seeders, what your library already has. Then it approves it, holds it for you or refuses it, and keeps the reasons. Approved items go to qBittorrent, Radarr, Sonarr or back to Seerr. Shadow mode decides without acting, so you can watch it first. A web UI that works from a phone, plus a Telegram bot.
short_desc: Checks every film, series or book against your rules before it downloads.
author: GeiserX
